title: Vocabulary fixture
description: Local copy of stapel-vocabularies/docs/vocabulary-fixture.schema.json (attributes-v2 spec §3.6). A vocabulary is levels + terms + edges (a DAG), not a tree of paths: a Term is unique by (vocabulary, level, code) and a TermEdge joins two terms of adjacent levels. Byte-stable: terms sorted by (level index, code), edges sorted as tuples.

prefixItems.description: Optional explicit sort rank within the level. The loader (stapel-vocabularies >= 0.1.4) prefers it over fixture row order; row order itself stays canonical (level index, code) for reviewability (VOC004). Omitted = row order, the historical behavior; `null` says the same thing, for a writer that has to cross this column to reach a later one (>= 0.4.1).

Optional curated popularity (stapel-vocabularies >= 0.2.0): > 0 puts the term in the level's popular band, highest first; 0 leaves it in the alphabet under the band. Distinct from sort, which ranks WITHIN a band. A row that OMITS this column — or states `null` — leaves whatever the live term holds rather than demoting it, so a catalogue re-import does not erase a band pushed from observed listing counts. An importer crossing this column to reach the next one writes `null`, never 0.

Optional free-form attributes the SOURCE CATALOGUE owns (stapel-vocabularies >= 0.4.0), e.g. {"hue": "#1a1a1a"} on a colour term so a facet can draw a swatch. Never part of identity — that stays (vocabulary, level, code) — and never a second place for a label. MERGED into the live term's bag on load, key by key.
